reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already covers missing, numeric and ranged amounts, and keeps scheduleModel.toExternal for the existing fields.

duplication.why: No amount logic is re-written; the only addition is a one-line call and a list type.

placement.why: Enrichment sits in the api/schedules-get handler with the new type in api-models.ts; arguably it could live in the scheduleModel mapper, but keeping toExternal unchanged for other uses is reasonable.

scope.why: Handler, type, handler signature, one test and a release note only.

maintainability.why: Small, typed and delegates the rule to the single shared definition.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the amount rule is called, not re-expressed.
